title: Finding A Voice: Exploring the Potential of African American Dialect and Voice Generation for Chatbots

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation by African American English (AAE) speakers rating chatbot responses translated into varying intensities of AAE (Low, Medium, High) versus Standard American English (SAE). The study measures metrics such as Inoffensiveness, Trustworthiness, and Role Appropriateness to assess if the models produce unnatural or offensive dialect generation.

Assessing the risk of reinforcing racial stereotypes by having in-group African American evaluators rate the offensiveness, cultural appropriateness, and similarity-to-self of LLM-generated African American English text and synthetically generated African American accented speech.
